state: Can is an unimplemented language draft, so compatibility with a compiler is not a constraint. Runtime already persists an atomic outbox with stable delivery identity, status, typed provider result, safe error, frozen localized payload, retries and reconciliation. Ordinary receipt retention is at least seven days; sensitive results remain subject to lifetime and current disclosure. send currently returns DeliveryResult {id,status}; capability completion carries delivery_id/status/result/error. Grant decide by reviewer checks assigned distinct account, submitted state, work location and budget, commits business decision then sends mail; its completion only mirrors status to application notice_state after matching notice_delivery. Propose send_offer by salesperson checks work location/draft/nonempty items/expiry, freezes total/state and sends notice; notification callback merely translates succeeded to delivered. Its PDF callback additionally checks current delivery, source/revision and attaches finalized file. Mail receive by mail_staff checks work location/unique source/live service, sends with dispatch guard and records id/status; completion also changes received to notified and copies provider reference. Reminders replace Mail current notification id. Late previous attempts must never affect current business reactions. No transport success implies approval, payment or read-by-recipient. Existing source type action(target) offers a precedent for a target-indexed opaque type, but delivery(target) would be a new explicitly specified primitive. Need one source/JS contract reducing true mirrors, preserving explicit domain handlers, present failure/unknown/skipped outcomes, lifetime/permissions, no arbitrary receipt lookup and no new manifest. No runtime or token benchmark exists.

association.instructions: Which complete mechanism best balances compact authoring and preservation of these boundaries?

criteria.typed_reference: Introduce delivery(Operation)? as an opaque same-owner association to the persistent typed outbox receipt, assigned from send. Read-only id/status/result/error replace pure status/reference mirrors; null means never associated. Keep safe summary while referenced, withhold expired/private result, and never mutate domain row version/trigger business hooks on receipt change. Current callback matching uses field.id; explicit handlers still own Mail notified transition and PDF validation/attachment. Costs: new type and precise lifetime/read-checkpoint rules.
criteria.associated_effect: Add send ... into row.field shorthand that generates a hidden receipt relation and copied status/result fields with inferred schemas, and uses field-scoped completion hooks for explicit business reactions. Existing renderer reads generated summary slots. It can eliminate more matching boilerplate, but adds effect syntax, generated writable-looking slots and ordering/lock/version semantics; underlying receipts still need disclosure and lifetime rules.
criteria.explicit_mirrors: Retain DeliveryResult id/status plus explicit app fields and completion handlers everywhere. Factor only shared UI status rendering and document safe error/retention rules. This adds no new reference or effect primitive, preserves visible updates and chosen domain history, but each app continues correlating current IDs and copying transport status/result and mapping equivalent enums.
